title: Wanderburg Console & Xbox Release Date — What We Know
description: Wanderburg console release date status: Early Access is PC/Steam (Sep 8, 2026); no official Xbox, PlayStation or Switch date has been announced yet.
note: No console store listing was found in research for this wiki. Treat any Xbox / PlayStation / Switch date as unannounced until Randwerk or Sidekick confirms it.

paragraphs: Wanderburg entered Steam Early Access on September 8, 2026 as a PC title. As of this page's last check, no Xbox, PlayStation, or Nintendo Switch release date has been officially announced.
If you searched "wanderburg xbox release date" or "wanderburg console release date", the honest answer is: not announced — only the Steam PC build has a confirmed date so far.
Steam lists Wanderburg (app 3624140) as an Early Access PC game, with a separate free demo (app 4268810).
Controller support exists on PC (mouse, keyboard, or gamepad) — that is not the same as a console port. See the Steam Deck notes on this wiki for handheld specifics.
Neither the developer (Randwerk) nor the publisher (Sidekick Publishing) has published a console store page in the materials reviewed here.

sections.h2: How to watch for a console version
paragraphs: The channels that would announce a port first are the Steam news hub for app 3624140, the official Discord, and Randwerk's YouTube.
Early Access is expected to run roughly 6–12 months; if a console version is planned, that window is where official messaging would most likely appear.
Be skeptical of third-party sites listing an Xbox or PS5 date that has no matching official announcement — those are usually guesses.
